title: Add XRechnung structured format reader for inbound e-documents
summary: Adds a structured format reader for German XRechnung e-documents that parses inbound XML directly into E-Document Purchase draft tables without requiring Data Exchange field mappings.
key_points: Implements IStructuredFormatReader interface for XRechnung format
Reads UBL Invoice and CreditNote documents into E-Document Purchase header and lines
Includes comprehensive tests and sample XRechnung XML test resource
Binds handler to E-Doc. Read into Draft enum for automatic routing
Supports German localization for e-document processing
